BackstoryDef.title: mercenary camp cadet
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in a fortified compound run by ruthless sellswords, [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that loyalty is bought with caps and bullets. While other youths farmed meager crops, [PAWN_pronoun] drilled with pre-war rifles and studied military tactics.

BackstoryDef.title: gunner syndicate commander
BackstoryDef.description: Rising through blood and iron to command the main headquarters of the Gunners, [PAWN_nameDef] runs [PAWN_possessive] mercenary army with cold corporate efficiency. Calculating and utterly amoral, [PAWN_pronoun] takes any contract that pays well and crushes anyone in the way.

BackstoryDef.title: ambitious militia recruit
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up in a struggling frontier town, [PAWN_nameDef] resented watching neighbors share scarce supplies with freeloaders. [PAWN_pronoun] joined the local militia not out of charity, but to gain weapons, training, and leverage over weaker settlers.

BackstoryDef.title: turncoat mercenary officer
BackstoryDef.description: Once a trusted officer among the Minutemen, [PAWN_nameDef] sold out [PAWN_possessive] own comrades at Quincy for a lucrative rank with the Gunners. Cynical and opportunistic, [PAWN_pronoun] now leads brutal assault squads from the ruins [PAWN_pronoun] helped conquer.

BackstoryDef.title: scrapyard brawler
BackstoryDef.description: Orphaned in the lawless outskirts of a ruined city, [PAWN_nameDef] survived by picking fights over salvaged armor plates and welding tools. [PAWN_pronoun] quickly discovered a knack for bolting heavy scrap onto makeshift frames and breaking bones up close.

BackstoryDef.title: armored shock lieutenant
BackstoryDef.description: Clad in heavily modified power armor, [PAWN_nameDef] delights in charging straight into enemy lines to smash defenders apart at close quarters. Fierce and merciless, [PAWN_pronoun] treats every raid as a chance to test new armor reinforcements in blood.

BackstoryDef.title: overpass scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: Raised amidst tangled highway wrecks and rusted shipping containers, [PAWN_nameDef] learned how to turn junkyards into fortified labyrinths. [PAWN_pronoun] mastered heavy weapons early to drive off rival gangs eyeing [PAWN_possessive] territory.

BackstoryDef.title: stronghold artillery captain
BackstoryDef.description: Commanding a heavily fortified auto-wrecker bastion, [PAWN_nameDef] enforces iron discipline with heavy machine guns and zero tolerance for failure. Pragmatic and ruthless, [PAWN_pronoun] turns every approach to [PAWN_possessive] outpost into a lethal killzone.

BackstoryDef.title: rooftop watchman
BackstoryDef.description: Quiet and patient from a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] spent hours perched on crumbling rooftops tracking radstags and passing caravans through cracked binoculars. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to control [PAWN_possessive] breathing and make every scarce round count.

BackstoryDef.title: mercenary overwatch sniper
BackstoryDef.description: Stationed on high catwalks and church steeples, [PAWN_nameDef] serves as the Gunners' deadliest long-range marksman. Detached and methodical, [PAWN_pronoun] picks off officers and medics from afar without a flicker of remorse.
